blurb: Guests can choose from various massage types such as Swedish, Deep Tissue, Sports/Orthopedic, Myofascial Release, Pregnancy, Couples, Cupping, and specialty treatments like Lavender Dreams and Reflexology/Reiki. Float therapy offers a weightless suspension experience in Epsom salt water to promote relaxation and pain relief. Additional services include infrared saunas and sound lounge sessions for enhanced physical and mental well-being.
